create_compiler_env_wrapper: create a custom wrapper class that extends CompilerEnvWrapper to transform a CompilerEnv environment
fork_wrapped_env: fork a wrapped CompilerEnv to create an independent copy with the same wrapper applied
create_action_wrapper: create an ActionWrapper subclass that translates actions between different action spaces
create_observation_wrapper: create an ObservationWrapper subclass that transforms observations to a new observation space
create_reward_wrapper: create a RewardWrapper subclass that transforms rewards to a new reward space
